newsitem.title: CHILE: Earthquake hits central Chile area, no injuries.
newsitem.headline: Earthquake hits central Chile area, no injuries.

text.p: An earthquake jolted northern Chile early on Sunday, startling residents but causing no immediate damage or injuries, a spokesman for the National Emergency Office said.
The spokesman said the quake was felt near the northern coastal city of La Serena and the mining town of Ovalle. Residents reported a long but not very powerful tremor.
"It woke some people up but there is no damage around here," Rodolfo Gonzalez, a schoolteacher in La Serena, told Reuters by telephone.

The national emergency spokesman said he had been in contact with regional offices near La Serena and no damage or injuries had been reported. Earlier, the Hong Kong Observatory said the quake, detected at 6:14 a.m. EDT (1014 GMT), was estimated to be 6.5 on the Richter scale.
